title: E2-only priming -> surface CD98
purpose: Discriminate competing representations of epithelial CD98 regulation without embryo involvement.
experiment: Run (or fix/stain at) the existing day 0-2 E2-only priming phase and measure epithelial surface CD98/CD9 protein.
ambiguity_tested: CD98-c versus BOTH CD98-a (v0.4) and CD98-b, which Gate 3a computes to be mutually indistinguishable in every recorded arm. So this measurement collapses the three CD98 readings to two classes; it does NOT separate CD98-a from CD98-b, and no available experiment does.
expected_effect: Opposite predictions: CD98-b (E_GP130_STAT3 or IN_HCG) predicts surface CD98 OFF under E2 alone; CD98-c (adds IN_E2) predicts ON. Verified from the committed model: E_PGR and E_GP130_STAT3 are false in all 32 assignments of e2_primed_maternal and IN_HCG is off.
open_uncertainty: Separating CD98-a from CD98-b needs an hCG arm (CAND-10), and IN_HCG is currently zero-degree, so that arm only becomes informative if CD98-b or CD98-c is adopted first. ADOC has no CD98/CD9 measurement at any timepoint and no E2-only transcriptome, so this is a NEW measurement, not a reanalysis. A transcript would not settle it: E_CD98_CD9 means surface availability and AGENTS.md separates expression from node activity.

title: LIF neutralisation -> pSTAT3
purpose: Separate extracellular LIF availability from common GP130/STAT3 pathway activity.
experiment: Neutralising anti-LIF (or LIFR blockade) during the maternal phase; read pSTAT3 and downstream epithelial receptive markers.
ambiguity_tested: E_LIF, E_GP130_STAT3 and E_CD98_CD9 are one rule-induced class, so anti-LIF, STAT3 inhibition and CD98 knockdown are a single intervention in v0.4. Both E_LIF and E_GP130_STAT3 are adjudicated ARTIFICIALLY_COUPLED.
expected_effect: If pSTAT3 survives LIF neutralisation, the asserted identity E_GP130_STAT3 = E_LIF is false and a second GP130 ligand is required. Marwood 2009 shows IL-11 and LIF have non-interchangeable downstream effects in human endometrial epithelium.
open_uncertainty: Whether LIFR blockade and LIF neutralisation are separable in ADOC. The model has no IL11 node, so a negative result constrains but does not identify the alternative ligand.

title: IL-11 exposure with LIF neutralised
purpose: Separate IL11-driven from LIF-driven GP130/STAT3 activity.
experiment: Recombinant IL-11 exposure combined with LIF neutralisation; read pSTAT3, ITGA2, surface CD98.
interrogates_concepts: IL11 ligand availability -- no model node exists (GP130-b would add X_IL11 as a free experimental input)
ambiguity_tested: Same alias as CAND-02, plus whether the GP130-b variant (E_GP130_STAT3 = E_LIF or X_IL11) is warranted.
expected_effect: Marwood 2009: IL-11 stimulates trophoblast attachment where LIF does not, and alpha2beta1 blockade reduces the LIF but not the IL-11 collagen-IV response -- both downstream of STAT3. GP130-b breaks the ligand/pathway alias but does NOT represent that divergence.
open_uncertainty: Two perturbations, so it does not fit a one-perturbation budget. Do not equate endogenous stromal IL11, epithelial exposure to IL11, and a recombinant ligand input.

title: STAT3 inhibition
purpose: Intervene downstream of LIF/IL11 to distinguish ligand-specific from common-pathway effects.
experiment: Selective STAT3 inhibition in a defined compartment; read pSTAT3 for target engagement plus epithelial receptive markers.
interrogates_concepts: stromal STAT3 -- NO model node exists (there is no S_STAT3); the seed proposal named one
ambiguity_tested: Same alias class as CAND-02. Less specific than ligand perturbation because it collapses every upstream signal onto one node.
expected_effect: Loss of the epithelial receptive program if the GP130/STAT3 arm is required. Mouse genetics (Pawar 2013, Hiraoka 2020) separate epithelial and stromal STAT3 roles; the model has only the epithelial one.
open_uncertainty: Compartment selectivity of a small-molecule STAT3 inhibitor in a two-channel chip is unproven. The model cannot represent stromal STAT3 at all, so a stromal effect would be uninterpretable.

title: Hormone cocktail minus cAMP
purpose: Determine the contribution of the cAMP arm of the decidualization protocol.
experiment: Standard maternal HT condition with cAMP omitted; read stromal decidual markers.
interrogates_concepts: EPAC/RAP1 -- deliberately NOT a model node; a rate-free Boolean model cannot express potentiation
ambiguity_tested: IN_cAMP and S_PKA are one class, both re-adjudicated ARTIFICIALLY_COUPLED on 2026-09-16: the model asserts cAMP acts only through PKA.
expected_effect: Reduced but not abolished decidualization. Kusama 2013 shows PKA inhibition attenuates rather than abolishes, and an EPAC-only arm is inert -- i.e. a graded potentiator, which Boolean logic cannot represent.
open_uncertainty: A partial effect is the predicted outcome and the Boolean model cannot distinguish 'attenuated' from 'abolished'. This may be evidence for a rate layer rather than a topology change.

title: SMO antagonist -> stromal NR2F2/HAND2/BMP2
purpose: Test the epithelial PGR/IHH -> stromal Hedgehog reception -> NR2F2/HAND2/BMP2 axis.
experiment: SMO antagonist (or PTCH1/GLI1 knockdown) in the stromal compartment; read PTCH1, GLI1, NR2F2, HAND2, BMP2.
interrogates_concepts: stromal PTCH1/SMO/GLI reception state -- NO model node; GAP-014
ambiguity_tested: E_PGR, S_PGR, E_IHH, S_NR2F2 and S_BMP2 are a five-member class: PGR activity, IHH availability and stromal reception are one intervention.
expected_effect: If Hedgehog reception is required, SMO blockade should lower stromal NR2F2 and BMP2 without changing epithelial PGR. Inserting a pass-through reception node is structurally INERT (35->35) -- it only helps if it carries an independently measurable state.
open_uncertainty: GAP-014: human EXPRESSION and pharmacological response exist (REF-075, Wei 2010), but the NECESSITY test does not. The causal chain rests substantially on mouse uterine genetics.

title: BMP signalling inhibition
purpose: Interrogate the stromal decidualization branch downstream of the IHH/NR2F2 axis.
experiment: BMP receptor / SMAD inhibition during decidualization; read decidual markers.
interrogates_concepts: BMP receptor / SMAD state -- candidate node, measured as structurally inert
ambiguity_tested: Whether BMP2 acts through a receptor/SMAD step distinct from the PGR/IHH/NR2F2 alias it currently collapses into.
expected_effect: Reduced decidualization if the BMP arm is required. Mouse Bmp2 conditional deletion abolishes the decidual response (Lee 2007).
open_uncertainty: Adding a BMP-SMAD pass-through node was MEASURED to be structurally inert and does not resolve the upstream alias. The experiment may still be biologically informative, but it must not be claimed to decouple the model.

title: PC6 knockdown -> alpha-DG-N shedding
purpose: Separate PC6 enzyme activity from its DAG1 cleavage product.
experiment: PCSK5/PC6 knockdown; measure full-length and N-terminally cleaved alpha-dystroglycan.
interrogates_concepts: cleavage-resistant DAG1 substrate -- a laboratory construct, not a state ADOC varies
ambiguity_tested: E_PC6 = E_DAG1_CLEAVED asserts the enzyme IS its product; both are adjudicated ARTIFICIALLY_COUPLED and the identity is directly contradicted by Heng 2015.
expected_effect: PC6 knockdown should reduce alpha-DG-N shedding while leaving substrate abundance; Heng 2015 performed both arms in human cells.
open_uncertainty: The separation is required by evidence, but no free PC6 determinant exists; the cleavage-resistant arm would supply one and it is not a physiological state.

title: HAND2 loss
purpose: Test the stromal HAND2 veto on epithelial proliferation, one of the few non-collapsed stromal nodes.
experiment: siHAND2 in the stromal compartment during HT; read stromal decidual markers and epithelial proliferation state.
ambiguity_tested: S_HAND2 is NOT_RULE_COLLAPSED -- it has its own Boolean function, so this perturbation already has a distinct model image, unlike most stromal targets.
expected_effect: Loss of the HAND2 veto should de-repress epithelial mitogenic signalling. Direction only: the magnitude of epithelial collapse is a hard Boolean consequence of a veto with no held-out measurement behind it.
open_uncertainty: Already encoded as a boundary input (IN_HAND2_LOSS) rather than as a mechanism, so the experiment tests the consequence of the veto, not its mechanism.

title: hCG challenge
purpose: Give a declared but unread input a model image, and test embryo-independent hCG effects on the epithelium.
experiment: Recombinant hCG exposure during the maternal phase; read surface CD98 and epithelial receptive markers.
ambiguity_tested: IN_HCG is declared but ZERO-DEGREE -- read by no rule -- so it currently has no model image at all. The CD98-b/c and CDH1-b/c variants would give it one.
expected_effect: Dominguez 2010 names hCG among the inducers of epithelial CD98. If CD98-b/c are adopted, hCG becomes readable on CD98 without progestin.
open_uncertainty: CONDITIONAL VALUE: the generator confirms this perturbation moves no maternal node in any recorded arm, because its input is zero-degree. It becomes informative only if the topology gains an image for it. REF-059 (Jin 2025) routes hCG through epithelial PGF2alpha to a stromal readout, and REF-069 (Schatz 1986) records progestin SUPPRESSING that epithelial source -- a registered unresolved conflict.

title: Anti-SPP1 -> attachment
purpose: Interrogate one terminal embryo-maternal adhesion route.
experiment: Neutralising anti-SPP1 during the embryo challenge; attachment fraction as the endpoint.
ambiguity_tested: Separates the two terminal interface relays, which the hormone-treated arm alone cannot: under IN_ANTI_SPP1 the endpoint stops depending on the SPP1 relay.
expected_effect: Reduced attachment if the SPP1 route is non-redundant. The relay pair is otherwise a one-dimensional ridge.
open_uncertainty: Its identifiability target is the relay abstraction now reinterpreted as unresolved terminal interface/penetrance variables and a candidate for removal. If the relays go, the parameters it uniquely identifies cease to exist.

title: XAV939 dropout
purpose: Test whether the WNT/tankyrase inhibitor in the standard cocktail has any maternal effect the model can see.
experiment: Standard HT condition with XAV939 omitted; read epithelial secretory and stromal decidual markers.
interrogates_concepts: E_AXIN -- referenced by the phase1b_xav939_required scenario override but ABSENT from the network
ambiguity_tested: IN_XAV939 is ZERO-DEGREE: present in every HT protocol and read by no rule, so the model predicts XAV939 does nothing. Any measured effect is unrepresented.
expected_effect: The model predicts NO change, because the input reaches nothing. An observed change would falsify the current encoding and motivate the E_AXIN gate the unused scenario already sketches.
open_uncertainty: CONDITIONAL VALUE: the generator confirms this perturbation moves no maternal node in any recorded arm, because its input is zero-degree. It becomes informative only if the topology gains an image for it. A null-prediction experiment: informative only if it fails. No primary reference in the corpus supports a specific XAV939 direction in human endometrium.

title: COX-2 / PGE2 pathway perturbation
purpose: Proposed from experimental planning material; assessed here rather than promoted.
experiment: Not specified -- would require a COX-2 inhibitor arm with prostaglandin readouts.
interrogates_concepts: COX-2/PTGS2 and PGE2 -- no model node, no catalogued target
ambiguity_tested: None that can be stated: there is no model representation to disambiguate.
open_uncertainty: ZERO occurrences of COX-2/PTGS2/PGE2 anywhere in the reference, evidence or node-candidate layers. The nearest evidence is REF-069 (Schatz 1986), which measures PGF2alpha -- NOT PGE2 -- and is registered as an unresolved CONTRADICTION against REF-059. Do not add topology for this.

purpose: Proposed from experimental planning material; assessed here rather than promoted.
interrogates_concepts: TLR3 and innate immune signalling -- no model node, no catalogued target
